        internet-archive-scan-pdf-ed4bc14e, at artifact page 335, printed page 281, n.
        544. The Ordo heads it De Communi pastorum, and this repository carries no
        Common, so the heading is recorded and not resolved. The Ordo prints its

        nn. 541, 544, 571, 617, 635, 655, 665 and 683 across the whole Proprium de
        Sanctis, and the entry all eight cite, n. 721,5 itself, in the Communia at
        artifact page 386, printed page 332 - and does not print the part letters alike
        in them: 7-8 at n. 541 and 7-8a at the other eight. All nine were read in the
        page images, five of them at 400 dpi. Each is recorded as printed rather than
        harmonized; the divergence is the book''s own. The Communia entry the
        cross-reference names reads 7-8a, so n. 541 stands alone against the very entry
        it cites. All eight sanctoral printings are now carried under separate identities.
        Nothing else of this Mass has been read - the Entrance and Communion Antiphons
        and the three orations are printed in the Missal, not in the Ordo, and are
        absent because no witness to them is on disk that this project may publish. See
